versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-live-assistant 0.0.2

- Adds explicit skill version reporting in API/CLI User-Agent headers (`/skill-version/{skill-version}`), sourced from the `SKILL_VERSION` environment variable or manifest.
- Updates cloud-calling logic in `live_stream_url_generator.py` and `live_theft_handler.py` for observability improvements.
- Clarifies and documents new observability requirement in SKILL.md.
- Removes outdated or redundant documentation (`skill-card.md` deleted).

Initial release of alibabacloud-live-assistant: Alibaba Cloud Live (ApsaraVideo Live) diagnostics in read-only mode.

- Diagnose live stream quality issues (stuttering, pixelation, A/V sync, bitrate/codecs) via stream probing.
- Probe CDN edge nodes for latency and route issues.
- Detect live traffic theft and anomalous billing using log analysis.
- Generate signed push/pull test URLs and check authentication setups safely.
- Record or snapshot live streams for local inspection.
- All operations are strictly read-only: never modifies any Alibaba Cloud Live configuration or streams.
